extraContent.description: Complete verse addressing the children of Ammon and their reproach, stating the sword is drawn for slaughter against them. This entire section (v33-v37) appears to be missing from the provided OSMAIN text which ends at v32.
Continuation of judgment on Ammon regarding false visions and lying omens, casting them upon the dead wicked.
Command to return the sword to its sheath and judgment in the place of origin.
Declaration of pouring out indignation and fire, delivering them into the hands of barbarous men.
Final declaration that they will become prey to fire, their blood will flow, and they will be forgotten.
